resources.name: Central Texas Food Bank
resources.description: Get free groceries through many food pantries and mobile food trucks. They help people with low income in Central Texas. You can also get help applying for SNAP (food stamps). Bring a photo ID if you have one, but they will not turn you away if you do not. Call or check the website to find a pantry close to ZIP 78702 and to see hours. Some sites are drive‑through, some are walk‑up. No one asks about immigration status. This group is a main food hub, not a walk‑in pantry. They will tell you where to go near your home.
resources.availability_status: Open - pantry partners and mobile food trucks vary by day and time

resources.name: El Buen Samaritano
resources.description: Get free groceries from a drive‑through food pantry. They focus on people with low income in South and East Austin, but others can ask for help too. You may also get help signing up for SNAP (food stamps) and health care programs. Bring a photo ID if you have one. They may ask for basic information like your name, address, and family size. No one asks about immigration status. Call or check the website for pantry days and times. Go early, because food can run out.
resources.availability_status: Open - pantry days and hours change, call or check online before going

resources.name: Society of St. Vincent de Paul – Diocesan Council of Austin
resources.description: Get help with food, like food pantry bags or food store cards. Help depends on what each local church group can offer. They serve people with low income in many Austin ZIP codes, including 78702. Call first. They will ask for your address and match you to the closest church group. Bring a photo ID and a bill or paper with your address if you have it. Help is not guaranteed every time, but they try to help when they can. Immigration status does not matter.
resources.availability_status: Open - help depends on funds and pantry stock, call for current options

resources.name: Sunrise Homeless Navigation Center (Sunrise Church Austin)
resources.description: Get free hot meals and snacks if you are homeless or very low income. They also offer showers, mail, and other basic help. No ID is needed to eat. People with any immigration status can come. This place is close to ZIP 78702, just east of downtown. Call or check the website for meal times and days. Food is first come, first served. They may also help you find other food pantries nearby.
resources.availability_status: Open - meal times can change, check before you go
